main_text.p: כנה כנֵי Pahel, Cognominavit, Cognomine vel titulo appellavit, Titulis usus fuit. Gen.4.26. in Jon. Ithpeh. אתכניאו Cognominati sunt, Jesa.1.4. Ethpahel Syriace, ܐܬܟܢܝ Cognominatus est, Matt.10.3.
כנוא Ch.Collegium, Societas, Esrae 5.6. Plur. כנותא Societates ejus, Esrae 4.7, ex forma Hebraea.
ܟܢܫܐ Syr.Confervus, Socius. Plural. ܟܢܫܐ Confervi, Matth.18.28.29.31.
כנמא כנם Hujusmodi, hunc in modum, In hanc sententiam, Esrae 5.4.11.

כנס Ch.Colligere, cogregare: Item Irasci, indignari, וכנסו Et indignati sunt, ut Hebraei explicant Esth.2.21. Posset etiam commode alias explicari, Et Convenerunt, congregati fuerunt. Sed legendum procul dubio בנסו per ב. Pahel כנס Idem.
כנע Ithpeh. אתכנע Ch.Deprimere, demittere, abjicere, humiliare se: Item Pudere, Pudore, rubore affici, erubescere.
אתכנעו, אתכנעות Ch. Depresio, humiliatio: Pudor, ignominia, opprobrium.
כנען Ch. & Syr. Chanaan: Terra Chananaea.
כנעניתא Ch. ܟܢܥܢܝܬܐ Syr. Cananaea mulier, Matt. 15.22. Genef.46.11.
כנף Ch. Colligere, congregare, Psal.41.7. Ithpehal Partic.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; vowel points and some Syriac letters are uncertain and may differ from the printed forms.
